title: Meet Carl… the Dungeon Has a Voice Now
author: This-Memory4929
selftext:
Hi everyone!

First of all, I wanted to thank this community for all the support you gave me when I released the demo.

The post I made here got way more attention than I expected and, honestly, it helped me a lot. Not just with visibility, but also because it gave me some motivation back to keep working on the game and improving it.

So really, thank you.

In the meantime, I kept working and quite a few things have changed.

After reading the feedback I received, I decided to improve a few things to make the whole experience more engaging.

So... meet **Carl**, the dungeon radio host.

He’s probably one of my favorite additions in this update.

Carl comments on what happens in the dungeon, often sarcastically, and sometimes he just talks because the silence was starting to get awkward.

So turn the volume up and give him some space. He’s stuck in there all day anyway.

There’s also a new staff member: the **Goblin Sweeper**.

Adventurers can now leave behind dirt, blood and even gold. And someone has to clean it up.

If the dungeon turns into a dump, customers will notice.

I’ve also worked quite a bit on the building system and the new purchase panel. Placing walls and floors is faster now, the catalog is easier to use, and in general I tried to remove some of the friction from the things you do all the time.

There are other new things too, but I’d rather not spoil everything here. If anyone wants to try them directly, the demo is updated.

Since this community already gave me some really useful advice, I also wanted to ask you something.

Do you think Fame & Fear is now in a solid enough state to properly face a Steam Next Fest?

At the moment, wishlists are still growing a little every day even without me doing much, while page traffic is still pretty small.

So I’m really curious to see what happens when the game gets shown to a lot more people.

For anyone who wants to check out the new update or try the demo:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4935730/Fame\_\_Fear\_Dungeon\_Architect/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4935730/Fame__Fear_Dungeon_Architect/)

Thanks again, seriously.

replies.author: This-Memory4929
replies.body: Honestly, I just picked the name because it fit well hahaha

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: It doesn't, you should probably change it. People will think this is Dungeon Crawler Carl.

replies.author: This-Memory4929
replies.body: Oh, I see! I’ll keep that in mind. If it causes confusion, I’ll change his name.

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: It caused confusion for me. I saw it and thought "Hm, a Dungeon Crawler Carl game"

replies.author: This-Memory4929
replies.body: Thanks for pointing that out! I don’t want it to cause confusion, so I’ll change his name to Max.

replies.author: This-Memory4929
replies.body: Oh my God, Carl already has enemies... 😂 Just kidding, why don’t you like him? You can disable him in-game anyway.
